comic-1.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. New artwork for a fantasy 2D game's comic intermission. Reference image is ONLY for character identities, pencil-and-paper art direction and current stone-bridge environment. Do NOT copy the reference's typography or UI. Landscape 16:9 composition. THREE VERTICAL COMIC PANELS side by side, separated by narrow dark hand-inked gutters; each third contains one complete shot. Graphite drawing and pen hatching on warm ivory paper, restrained watercolor color accents: orange beard/gold armor, purple for Layla, teal for Lupinor. Three companions: Tholgrin, SHORT BROAD dwarf male with long ginger beard, full plate, sacred mace and round shield; Layla, ADULT human-looking blonde woman with ponytail, practical purple leather rogue armor/cloak and psionic daggers; Lupinor, ADULT male silver-haired slender elf warrior in dark armor and teal cloak, scimitar and wrist crossbow. Exactly these characters, consistent faces and equipment, natural proportions, no extra limbs. Environment: ruined medieval stone bridge paved with irregular flagstones, broken stone balustrade, mountain gorge and ruined gothic abbey, small braziers. No modern objects. Reserve clean pale atmosphere in upper quarter and lower quarter for code-drawn speech balloons; do not draw balloons or letters. No UI, text, logos, labels, numbers or watermark. Polished illustrated fantasy sketchbook, not pixel art, no 3D, no anime faces. First respite after a skirmish. Panel 1: wide three-quarter view of all three standing on the bridge, Tholgrin in foreground lowers his mace, Layla turns toward the road, Lupinor watches from behind. Panel 2: medium portrait Layla at left, looking toward Tholgrin at right, one lowered violet dagger and a wry relaxed smile. Panel 3: medium portrait Lupinor at right, teal cloak, looking past the broken bridge rail toward distant ruins, companions' shoulders visible at left. Daylight, smoke wisps, quiet relief.
